title: Quietly Simmered Uruguayan Dulce De Leche Bowl
description: A traditional Uruguayan dessert featuring caramel sauce, this dish is perfect for a lazy Sunday, its yeasty and molten texture sure to satisfy any sweet tooth, and its gentle preparation method makes it suitable for a Buddhist temple setting, served in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yeast, salt, and 1 tablespoon of warm water to activate the yeast.
In a large earthenware bowl, combine the sweetened condensed milk, water, vanilla extract, and yeast mixture.
Add the unsalted butter to the bowl and stir until it is fully incorporated.
Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and place it in the oven.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and simmer the mixture for 45 minutes.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Remove the aluminum foil and whisk the mixture until it is smooth and creamy.
Return the bowl to the oven and simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened into a caramel sauce.
